Claire.presenting_problem: I’ve developed a fear of driving on motorways after having a panic attack while driving last year.
Claire.timeline: It started about 8 months ago after a very stressful period at work.
Claire.thoughts: I keep worrying that I might lose control of the car or cause an accident.
Claire.feelings: I feel anxious and trapped even thinking about driving on motorways.
Claire.body: My chest feels tight, my hands sweat, and my heart starts racing.
Claire.past: I had a panic attack in a supermarket a few years ago during another stressful period.
Claire.goal: I want to feel calm and confident when driving again.
Claire.hypnosis_question: Will I still be in control during hypnosis?

Daniel.presenting_problem: I’ve been struggling with anxiety around my performance at work.
Daniel.timeline: It really started after I was promoted last year and given more responsibility.
Daniel.thoughts: I keep thinking I’m going to fail or disappoint people somehow.
Daniel.feelings: I feel overwhelmed and constantly under pressure.
Daniel.body: I get a heavy feeling in my chest and a lot of tension in my shoulders.
Daniel.past: I’ve always put a lot of pressure on myself to succeed, even when I was younger.
Daniel.goal: I want to feel calmer and more confident in my role.
Daniel.hypnosis_question: How can hypnotherapy help with confidence?

Sophie.presenting_problem: It feels like everything becomes too loud and overwhelming when I’m in crowded places.
Sophie.timeline: It’s been gradually building over the past couple of years.
Sophie.thoughts: My mind starts spiralling when there’s too much activity around me.
Sophie.feelings: I feel overwhelmed and like I need to escape.
Sophie.body: It feels like a wave rising in my chest and everything becomes too much.
Sophie.past: I remember feeling something similar at school when I felt judged or under pressure.
Sophie.goal: I want to feel calmer and more in control in busy environments.
Sophie.hypnosis_question: What does hypnosis actually feel like?

Mark.presenting_problem: I’ve been struggling with sleep and feeling anxious most nights.
Mark.timeline: It started during a stressful period at work about a year ago.
Mark.thoughts: At night my mind keeps going over everything that could go wrong.
Mark.feelings: I feel uneasy and constantly on edge.
Mark.body: My stomach feels tight and I find it hard to relax properly.
Mark.past: It reminds me of when I was younger and used to worry a lot about school and expectations.
Mark.goal: I want to be able to switch off and sleep peacefully again.
Mark.hypnosis_question: Can hypnosis help me quiet my mind at night?
